task_name: Implement idempotent WhatsApp invoice reminders and scheduler

concerns_addressed: P3-INT-001 resolved: closed-invoice suppression is now persisted as InvoiceReminder::SUPPRESSED (apps/api/app/Models/InvoiceReminder.php:23) instead of SENT, so it is no longer double-counted as provider success.

Both suppression paths set SUPPRESSED with sent_at null and recording suppression last_error (apps/api/app/Services/InvoiceReminderStateService.php:47-55 and :52-65), matching the phase-pass fix instruction.

Terminal-state guards now treat SUPPRESSED as terminal: claimLocked returns null for SUPPRESSED (InvoiceReminderStateService.php:14) and suppressClosedRetry bails if already SUPPRESSED (InvoiceReminderStateService.php:42), so suppressed rows are never retried.

No provider call on closed-before-retry: corrected RetryScenarios asserts callsBeforeRetry == sendTextCalls (apps/api/tests/Feature/Support/InvoiceReminderRetryScenarios.php:148-153) and the new cross-service test asserts providerCallCount unchanged (apps/api/tests/Feature/InvoiceReminderSuppressionMetricsTest.php:48,102).

Bounded history remains visible: the new test fetches /api/finance/reminders and asserts the suppressed row is present with status SUPPRESSED, sent_at null, failed_at null and invoice_id preserved (InvoiceReminderSuppressionMetricsTest.php:142-152), and the history controller still exposes status/sent_at/failed_at unfiltered (apps/api/app/Http/Controllers/InvoiceReminderController.php:62-83).

Invoice immutability preserved: the new test asserts the closed invoice still reads PAID with paid_amount and balance_amount unchanged (InvoiceReminderSuppressionMetricsTest.php:154-156); the corrected trait still asserts attempt and idempotencyKey stability (InvoiceReminderRetryScenarios.php:148-150).

Attempts are bounded: closed-before-retry asserts same beforeAttempts after suppression (InvoiceReminderRetryScenarios.php:150) and new test asserts attempts==0 (InvoiceReminderSuppressionMetricsTest.php:108).

Verification on the correction included the new regression (InvoiceReminderSuppressionMetricsTest: 1 test, 22 assertions) alongside Timing/Retry/History/PostgreSQL concurrency coverage on HEAD; the correction INFO note records 71 tests / 885 assertions passing with 1 known PostgreSQL-only skip.

strengths: Correction diff is surgical: 3 production hunks (SUPPRESSED constant, two terminal guards, two suppression branches) plus a focused metrics guard, no out-of-scope file changes.

Status naming is cohesive: SUPPRESSED is a verb-derived complement to SENT/FAILED/PENDING and is included in InvoiceReminder::statuses() (InvoiceReminder.php:57) without adding any new enum validation.
Terminal-state handling is consistent: both claimLocked and suppressClosedRetry batch the same three-element terminal set, avoiding split-logic drift.

Test isolation is clean: InvoiceReminderSuppressionMetricsTest uses RefreshDatabase, counting WhatsAppClient wrapper (lines 131-155), and direct InvoiceReminder seed (lines 64-71) without mocking invoice/reminder/database, matching the packet's test-doubles rule; Carbon is restored in tearDown.

No function-size regression: the longest touched helpers remain single-purpose (claimLocked, suppressClosedRetry, suppressClaim, reminderCounts) with no new branching complexity beyond the SUPPRESSED guard.
